_what: Certified pairs a lane runs on outside the replay variant index (pipeline/uk_certified_pairs.py). Each is one policyengine.py release's certified bundle, in the replay variant's identity shape, under the id pair-<variant slug>. Never a replay variant: no event replay runs on one.

certification.source: policyengine.py 6.11.0 packaged bundle manifest (policyengine/data/bundle/manifest.json, sha256 bccf23acde631aed4665757094c04f86e60993fb9d388e7dc958b90c876e5a80; PyPI wheel sha256 b2aa90b97a5c608f4aaad5e6833c21014d786bfd96bb831c9c51b9bb60ff2a50); the pair was certified in PolicyEngine/policyengine.py#685 (merged 2026-10-21)

data_years_evidence.source: Measured for the same policyengine-uk 2.132.6, policyengine-core 3.33.3 and dataset by the experiment population probe under policyengine 6.10.0 (data/uk/experiments/probes/exp-pe6.10.0_uk2.132.6_microcosm-uk-2024-25-national-20261019T083323Z-6cba5d71.json); every lane run checks its managed simulation's sim.dataset.years against this list before any calculation.

pairs.note: policyengine.py 6.11.0 (released 25 October 2026) with the pair its bundle certifies: policyengine-uk 2.132.6 and the Microcosm UK 2024-25 national cut built with it. A lane runs on it before the release-replay pipeline qualifies it; no event replay runs on it.

certification.source: Every Budget-day receipt of PolicyEngine/uk-autumn-budget-dashboard-2026 at 1eca3182 (results/uk/ab2026/MANIFEST.json) records execution_receipt.certificate: bundle_version 6.11.1, certified_for_model_version 2.151.0, certified_for_core_version 3.33.3, certified_dataset_sha256 b96a8cd6..., compatibility_basis built_with_model_package, certificate_sha256 f2e6fc9faafab32b50c1c76067fb070ae9686b6f375e44417776de16e9c3521f. The package RECORD and wheel digests, the packaged bundle manifest digest, the dataset size and the requirements freeze come from the receiver's qualification of the same pair (#242, request 5d4c83c0, receipt 50fe9740), since no dashboard receipt states them.

data_years_evidence.source: Every Budget-day receipt records dashboard.dataset_years and execution_receipt.supported_years as 2024 to 2032; the receiver's probe measured the same years for this pair (#242).

pairs.note: policyengine.py 6.11.1 with the pair its bundle certifies: policyengine-uk 2.151.0 and the Microcosm UK 2024-25 national cut of 25 October 2026. The UK Autumn Budget dashboard's Budget-day runs, whose artifacts give AB2026's counterparts (#230), record this pair in their receipts; they ran on Modal under Python 3.13.3 and the dashboard's own lock, which this record doesn't bind. The identity equals the replay variant #242 qualified, so its digest matches that variant's. No event replay runs on it here.
